correctness.rationale: Two strictly increasing class-cost difference curves have ordered interior zeros. At any aggregate flow below a both types strictly take road 1; above b both strictly take road 2. Between a and b, classes strictly choose opposing roads, forcing x=theta. At endpoints one indifference permits the unique indicated mix. The resulting piecewise clamp is exhaustive. Completing the square of affine total emissions yields positive curvature v+z, sharp iff interior criterion 2a-b<z/(v+z)<b, both plateau boundary regimes, and exact strictly positive gains. An all-rational witness and 18,000 exact rational Wardrop instances were checked, not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The motivated gap in a 2022 two-road eco-routing comparison is the omitted mixed market penetration, despite available multiclass VI formalism. The present exact classification proves when an intermediate adoption fraction strictly beats both pure endpoints and supplies the exact cost of endpoint-only comparison. The three sharp parameter regimes and rational witness make it a falsifiable structural two-road benchmark; no empirical calibration or broad-network extrapolation is claimed.
